purpose: R06 reconciliation: every Phase 1 gate, its evidence on the current candidate, and the single thing blocking it. Statuses: PASS (evidence on the candidate), LOCAL (evidence complete except deployed exercise), GAP (capability or coverage missing), BLOCKED (needs a credential, spend approval, device or owner decision), OWNER (owner action only).

R01.detail: reconciled candidate committed, cloud build pinned by digest, lint/format/mypy clean, 13,898 tests green on an earlier commit and a rerun in progress on the current production code, 224 browser checks

R02.detail: validate, lifecycle deploy/rollback and backup dry-runs pass; 114 t22/readiness tests pass
R02.blocking: owner spend approval (~$1 actual, $10 cap) for the qualification target

R03.detail: encrypted backup dry-run restores with artifacts and records matching (READY_FAKE)
R03.blocking: P06 provider objects and the deployed target

R04.detail: all three stop controls exist and are tested locally, including concurrent checkout serialisation protecting the cohort cap
R04.blocking: deployed exercise of the switches on the durable target

R05.detail: support tables explicitly classified; 33 operational tables fall back to protected-unknown (non-blocking, never purge-eligible); diagnostic bundles N/A (no export feature)
R05.blocking: legal/financial retention periods (owner) and a populated-environment bearer-link check

P01.detail: mandatory reading cannot be bypassed, replays do not re-call providers, literal vs adopted provenance distinct

P02.evidence: docs/ROADMAP.md P02 row (corrected to the Foxx A56)
P02.detail: budget Android (Foxx A56) is a harsh floor; emulation does not satisfy the gate
P02.blocking: physical iPhone and a mid-range Android, or a recorded coverage limitation

P03.detail: stop semantics proven (no charge, hold released, frozen packet untouched); assisted restart absent because one intake per workspace and one workspace per owner are both enforced
P03.blocking: owner decision A (same-workspace second transaction) or B (fresh workspace with lineage)

P04.detail: four-case deployed live OCR + .gov research trial
P04.blocking: live provider scope plus the durable target

P05.detail: Resend delivery, prefetch safety, 15-minute link expiry
P05.blocking: live email credential and the durable target

P06.detail: joined Stripe+Lob case, signed webhook replay, PDF/envelope proof inspection
P06.blocking: Stripe test-mode secret key; Lob test key already validated

P07.detail: support remedy without delay, responder acknowledgement, support-code routing
P07.blocking: deployed target and a named responder

P08.evidence: increment receipt p08_rules_modal plus earlier P08 notes
P08.detail: landing page, Rules modal, Step-4 checkout offer, confirmation/stop emails and price arms agree on clerical scope, no outcome guarantee, and hold/refund terms

J01-J04.evidence: journey event/capture/context/timeline suites, ai spends caps, isolation and idempotency suites
J01-J04.detail: server milestones distinct from browser observations, pause/budget reasons recorded, idempotent state transitions covered

J05.detail: no outcome follow-up cadence exists; consent/permission machinery and Resend adapter do exist

M02.detail: ledger distinguishes billed vs unknown only, deliberately never estimating; AI reservations and mail estimates live in their own stores; documented cohort report runs cleanly and fails safe
M02.blocking: owner decision A (three-state ledger) or B (align M02 wording)

R07.detail: activation packet compiled from receipts once Steps 1-6 close
R07.blocking: owner signature and the gates above
